tools.name: meom-public-list-services
tools.description: Lists the services MEOM (a Finnish B2B website agency) offers, as published on meom.fi: id, name, page URL, a short summary, section headings, how the service is delivered (process text and steps) and the questions answered in the page FAQ. Pass a service id to get that service with its FAQ answers.

tools.name: meom-public-list-experts
tools.description: Lists the MEOM team as shown on the meom.fi About page: name, job title, short bio and photo URL. Bios are in Finnish. Contact details are not included; use get-booking-link to get in touch.

tools.name: meom-public-get-booking-link
tools.description: Returns the link where a person can book a meeting with MEOM (HubSpot Meetings), the contact page URL and the sales email address. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "meom-public-list-proof-points" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: meom-public-list-services, meom-public-list-references, meom-public-list-experts, meom-public-list-proof-points, meom-public-get-booking-link · Private data: meom-public-list-experts, meom-public-list-proof-points, meom-public-get-booking-link · Public sink: meom-public-get-booking-link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: meom-public-list-services, meom-public-list-references, meom-public-list-experts, meom-public-list-proof-points, meom-public-get-booking-link · Private data: meom-public-list-experts, meom-public-list-proof-points, meom-public-get-booking-link · Public sink: meom-public-get-booking-link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
